one_month_reasoning: Spot fell to $150.96 on 2026-11-18 (-2.9%) after a beat-and-raise print (Q3 $115.8B vs ~$109B; Q4 guide $130B vs ~$124.9B modeled, src 7) because the CEO vacancy and the DOJ/Commerce Megaspeed probe dominate. Window to 2026-12-17: dividend record 12-02; Oracle (~12-09) and Broadcom (~12-10) results and their AI capex/backlog read-throughs; the FOMC (12-08/09); any CEO-search, Megaspeed or export-rule news (two-sided, fat-tailed); Micron's results around 12-17 on HBM pricing. Post-earnings drift after a large beat argues mildly up, the six-week downtrend and governance overhang argue down; I center the lognormal at ~$153 (between the 11-18 close and the ladder's $155.46) with ~14% one-month vol, above the 39%/3.5 = 11% base because realized volatility is elevated (-36% in a month, src 8).

downside.story: A CY2028 digestion year arrives early: customer AI capex lands ~20% under the base (CY2027 ~1.47T, CY2028 ~1.80T) as buyers absorb 2026-27 capacity and NVDA stops financing marginal neoclouds/labs; capture slips to ~0.32 on ASIC gains; GM 68-70% on memory costs and price competition; FY2029 EPS ~$12-13; the market pays ~9x for falling estimates under an unproven CEO.

base.story: Customer AI capex follows the standing base (CY2027 +50%, CY2028 +22%); NVDA capture rises with Vera Rubin then fades as ASICs gain and financing support is cut; FY2028 revenue $680B, EPS ~$15.6 (at consensus), FY2029 $797B, EPS ~$18.3 with GM easing to ~70.7%; the market keeps most of today's discount (12x NTM).

upside.story: Capex keeps beating (+12% vs base, toward the file high), Vera Rubin lifts capture to ~0.37, GM holds ~73%, a credible permanent CEO is named and the Megaspeed probe clears; P/E re-rates to ~16x.

reasoning: Lane: skeptic. The print was strong (Q3 $115.8B, +7.3% over guide; Q4 guide $130B; FY2028 ~+75% per Kress as interim CEO), so the downside is not the next two quarters. It is (1) the CEO vacancy after Huang's 2026-11-12 resignation and the Megaspeed export probe, class action and governance overhang (src 7, 8, 11, 12); (2) a financing loop: $109.7B of equity stakes in customers/labs, guarantees up to $105B, $102B cloud/lease commitments, DSO up to ~64 days on extended terms, and a July CDS spike to a record 82bp (src 1, 5, 7, 13, 14); Kress now says support will be 'less' (src 8), which removes some ACIE demand; (3) the cycle: FY2028 demand rests on customer capex +50% in CY2027 with no 2027 dollar guides yet. Build: customer AI capex (standing file base, reconciled to Q3 actuals: Big-4 2026 ~730B vs 733B) x capture, which rises with Vera Rubin content per GW then fades; plus Edge; GM per Kress's Q4 bottom and 72-73% recovery but to ~70.7% in FY2029 (mid-cycle year 3); opex from the run-rate. Result: FY2028 $680.2B (8% under guide, 6% under the post-print $723.9B consensus), FY2029 $797B (12% under the $903B consensus), EPS ~$15.6 / ~$18.3. The market already prices much of this at 9.9x NTM; the default k = 0.8 shrink to a peer median of 21.6x gives 11.6x, so the research target sits above spot even on a below-consensus FY2029. The left tail is fatter (P10 -47% from base vs P90 +53%), from a capex -20% / capture -3pt / GM -2.5pt / 9x case. Sources: 11 of the 19 non-filing sources are in lane (sell-side downgrades, litigation, DOJ probe, credit/CDS and circular-financing journalism, call statements on financing and receivables); the 7 older releases plus the 10-K/10-Q/8-K are the basic-fact guidance record the brief allows. Every outside forecast carries its publication date inside its window as of 2026-11-19: consensus pages state 2026-11-02 (TIKR) and 2026-11-09 to 11-18 (StockAnalysis); sell-side 11-10 and 11-14; industry 2026-10-05 (AI capex file, reconciled with Q3 actuals, newer-search logged) and 2026-11-01 (UAO). Undated Yahoo pages and the undated FourWeekMBA tally were replaced. The run's peers.md consensus (2026-10-26) was past the 21-day window and was replaced. Research limits: several pages blocked (investinglive, americanbazaar, blockspace, roic.ai, cryptobriefing, Q3 transcript PDF); Twelve Data estimates and insider data need a higher plan, so insider selling is not covered. Custom leg is driver-linked; no legs are left unlinked.

model_inputs.structure_note: Quarterly driver set (actual = 7 quarters through Q3 FY2027). Revenue = customer AI capex x NVDA capture + Edge; EBIT = revenue x GM - opex. Value is carried by the horizon multiples on the build's own NTM figures at 2027-11-17 (P/E 11.6x, weight 0.45; FCF yield 6.3%, 0.30 = 40% of the P/E+FCF weight) and a playbook normalised-earnings custom leg (0.25, driver-linked through driver_build.set). No DCF (policy). No SOTP: Edge is 7% of revenue. Equity holdings, guarantee and litigation enter as adjustments. FY2029 (year 3) is set as a mid-cycle-margin year (GM ~70.7%, EBIT ~64%), not a peak.
model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) capture path 0.335-0.36 FY2028 then fading to 0.32: the guide-implied FY2028 capture (~0.385) would add ~$65B revenue (~+6-7% target); holding 0.33 flat would cut ~4%; (2) FY2029 GM fade to 70%: holding 72.5% is ~+4%; (3) exit k at the default 0.8 (k = 1, discount persists as HSBC assumes, is ~-6%). New driver set: under rule 2 it needs Kilian's approval before booking; this forecaster could not post a card. peers.md NTM figures were not used: its consensus snapshot is dated 2026-10-26 (24 days, beyond the 21-day window) and MRVL's price has since fallen 36%; peer NTM P/E were rebuilt from 2026-11-18 closes and StockAnalysis consensus pages dated 2026-11-09 to 11-13. Only 3 genuine whole-company peers. Financing events: none >= 20% (NVDA is net cash with $227B buyback room). fair_value.value equals the engine base horizon value.
